module.description: Nested details upgraded with the APG keyboard model: one tab stop, arrows, Home/End and typeahead. Every branch opens with no script.
module.name: tree

ui.guidance: It is built from nested `details` elements, so with no JavaScript every branch still opens and every leaf is still reachable. The controller adds the APG keyboard model on top - roving focus, arrows, Home/End and typeahead - by upgrading this markup rather than replacing it. A div-based tree would have to implement disclosure, keyboard and semantics all at once, and would offer nothing when any of the three failed.
ui.keyboard: A roving tabindex gives the tree one tab stop; ArrowUp/ArrowDown move between visible nodes, ArrowRight opens a branch or steps into it, ArrowLeft closes it or steps out, Home/End jump to the ends, and printable characters start typeahead.
ui.name: tree

ui.guidance: This is a table, because the data is rows and columns and a table already reports both. Depth is carried by aria-level on each row rather than by indentation alone: indentation is a visual convention that conveys nothing to a screen reader, and "level 3" is the fact the user needs.
